description: Record of ONE Spanish company when you already have its tax ID (CIF/NIF). Use it to find out whether it exists and is active, its legal name, legal form (with ISO 20275 code), LEI, CNAE activity code, province and incorporation date; on the Pro plan, also its registered office, revenue band, sole shareholder, parent company and, with include_directors, its current directors. On every plan it flags whether the Spanish Tax Agency has revoked (or reinstated) its tax ID according to the BOE gazette (tax_id_revocation): a revoked tax ID is not valid for tax purposes and banks cannot process payments to or from it. If you do not have the tax ID, use search_companies; to decide on onboarding (KYB), use verify_company. Uses 1 request. Búsqueda de empresa española por CIF.

cif.description: Spanish company tax ID (CIF/NIF), e.g. A46103834 (spaces and hyphens are accepted)

include_directors.description: true to include current directors and officers (Pro and Business plans)
